messages:
sam: FYI onboarding Hydra13b-int3 (per-head int3 on attn) failing our summarization evals; names getting swapped in outputs ~11%
nina: did we change rotary representation or head layout during quantize?
sam: quant run used oqt v1.4 with per-head scale export. exporter wrote `rotary_scale` as per-head float16 array. runtime currently treats rotary_scale as single float32 unless meta says per-head.
oscar: runtime supports per-head, but only if `head_map` present. exporter didn't include head_map because it applied an internal permutation for kernel packing.
sam: so two problems: missing head_map + dtype mismatch. result: runtime broadcasts previously and ended up reusing wrong phase for many heads -> slot swaps.
qa-bot: regression-alert: summarization-suite entity-consistency dropped 10.7% at 2025-09-03T08:23:11Z
nina: short-term mitigation: coerce per-head arrays to float32 and compute a merged median scale as broadcast. that should restore behavior close to fp16.
oscar: did that locally — broadcast median fixed ~9% -> 1.4% swap rate. perf cost acceptable.
sam: long-term: exporter should always emit `head_map` and `rotary_scale_type` in metadata; runtime should validate head_map vs canonical ordering and fail fast if absent.
ci-bot: note: nightly quant job produced Hydra13b-int3 artifacts at 2025-09-03T01:05:00Z lacking head_map field. Marking build as broken.
oscar: I'll open a PR in oqt exporter to include head_map and write rotary_scale as explicit type+dtype. also add a unit test simulating a kernel-packing permutation.
sam: QA repro snippet:
```
# QA reproducer
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
print(c.generate(model='hydra13b-int3', prompt=open('samples/news-001.txt').read(), max_tokens=64))
```
nina: also add a small calibration job that, when per-head scales are present, recomputes phase offsets on a short corpus and writes a calibrated per-head correction vector into runtime cache. That lets per-head survive quantization safely.
sam: agreed. tagging @oscar on PR and will hold rollout until patched artifacts land.
__meta: generated by dataset generator: hydra13b per-head int3 rotary_scale/exporter head_map missing causing summarization entity swaps
